args.title: Bellwether Office: Warehouse automation in 2026
args.body:
- Newsletter: Bellwether Office's latest issue covers "Warehouse automation in 2026," linking to a blog article and a companion piece accessible via free email registration.
- Article (blog.bellwether.example/2026/warehouse): Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
- Companion piece (insights.bellwether.example): The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.
